changes.oldText: Primary Color overrides the main accent color of the selected theme. Two color pickers are provided — one for Light mode and one for Dark mode — so each display mode can use a different accent color.
changes.oldHtml: Primary Color overrides the main accent color of the selected theme. Two color pickers are provided — one for Light mode and one for Dark mode — so each display mode can use a different accent color.

changes.oldText: Click the color swatch of the mode you want to change
changes.oldHtml: Click the color swatch of the mode you want to change

changes.oldText: Choose a color from the picker, or enter a hex value
changes.oldHtml: Choose a color from the picker, or enter a hex value

changes.oldText: The new accent color is applied to the WebUI immediately
changes.oldHtml: The new accent color is applied to the WebUI immediately

changes.oldText: Clear a picker to fall back to the color that the selected theme provides for that mode. Clicking the setting's reset button clears both modes and restores the theme's own colors.
changes.oldHtml:
Clear a picker to fall back to the color that the selected theme provides for
that mode. Clicking the setting's reset button clears both modes and restores
the theme's own colors.

changes.oldText: Like the Theme setting, Primary Color appears only when your administrator has enabled theme customization.
changes.oldHtml: Like the Theme setting, Primary Color appears only when your administrator has enabled theme customization.
